## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #

---

## 📝 Summary
Adds an API reference document for the `POST/GET/DELETE /v1/tools/plugin_bindings` endpoints introduced in the plugin multi-tenancy feature. The doc covers authentication requirements, all request/response schemas, per-plugin configuration payloads (`OUTPUT_LENGTH_GUARD`, `RATE_LIMITER`, `SECRETS_DETECTION`), mode semantics, error responses, and runtime resolution behaviour — written for the WXO team as an external-facing integration reference.
